subject.title: Cross-provider fallback should respect provider trust boundaries for images/attachments

question: What provider media trust boundary should OpenClaw enforce when model fallback crosses providers with images or attachments?
rationale: The current source proves the gap, but the permanent default changes privacy, compatibility, and upgrade behavior, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add explicit media trust policy
options.body: Add a documented fallback media trust control with compatibility-preserving default behavior and an opt-in stricter mode, plus tests and doctor/docs coverage.

options.title: Strip cross-provider media by default
options.body: Make cross-provider fallback fail closed for media, accepting the compatibility cost for users who currently rely on image forwarding.

options.title: Accept configured fallback as media consent
options.body: Close the issue only if maintainers decide that configuring a fallback provider is intentionally consent for all prompt media classes.

recommendation.title: Add explicit media trust policy
recommendation.body: Add a documented fallback media trust control with compatibility-preserving default behavior and an opt-in stricter mode, plus tests and doctor/docs coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work by vincentkoc owns the CLI fallback image replay path most directly affected by the trust decision.
